# Module

## Summary
A week-or-so bundle of lessons with its assignments and quizzes and a Release Rule. Own card so cohorts release it and attendance points at its live lessons.

## Usage
`linksToMany(() => Module)` from Course; `releases[].module` from Cohort.

## Non-goals
Does not know which cohorts released it.
attributes.cardDescription: A week-sized bundle of lessons, assignments and quizzes, with a release rule saying when a cohort sees it.
